note: Massac County GIS Hub (gis-massac-county.hub.arcgis.com) publishes no queryable zoning district service. Its only zoning item is a PDF map of the City of Metropolis (Hub document bbdb5731...). Searches of ArcGIS Online and Hub for Massac zoning returned no county or city zoning FeatureServer/MapServer; the only zoning-named service found (services.arcgis.com/f4rR7WnIfGBdVYFd Zoning_Districts) is for a different jurisdiction (chapter-numbered codes, not Massac). Metropolis zoning is published only as a PDF map and in the city code (codelibrary.amlegal.com), so this county is viewer-only at best.
